n: Day of AI: Truth, Tricks, and AI
t: A one hour Day of AI lesson on hallucinations, deepfakes, and checking claims.
steps: Find the unit on the Day of AI site.
Register or log in to view the educator guide and student resources.
Read the Day of AI privacy notice.
Pick the examples of deepfakes and AI errors that suit your class.
Plan one or two class periods.
Run the lesson and have students practice on a real claim.
